en: The Information & Communications Technology Services Unit (ICT-SU) of Bukidnon State University. It handles the technical aspect of university processes involving information systems, network, technical services, and web development. ICT-SU is also responsible for maintaining all computers in the computer laboratories, and ensures that any issues or damages in the labs are addressed promptly. You may also approach them for technical assistance regarding computer facilities.
ceb: Ang Information & Communications Technology Services Unit (ICT-SU) sa Bukidnon State University. Mao sila ang ga-atiman sa teknikal nga bahin sa mga proseso sa unibersidad lakip ang information systems, network, technical services, ug web development. Sila usab ang ga-mentinar sa mga computer sulod sa computer laboratory, ug kung naay mga posibleng damage sa mga computers, sila usab ang ga-ayo niini. Pwede ka mo-doul sa ila alang sa tabang sa technical nga aspeto sa computer facilities.

en: For your official BukSU institutional email or student email login, go to the ICT office on the 3rd floor of the Finance Building and ask for assistance with your institutional email account.
Bring your validated COR or student ID if available, because ICT may need to verify that you are an officially enrolled student.
Students may also ask ICT for help if they forgot their institutional email, cannot log in, or need account recovery.
ceb: Para sa imong opisyal nga BukSU institutional email o student email login, adto sa ICT office sa 3rd floor sa Finance Building ug pangayo og tabang bahin sa imong institutional email account.
Dad-a ang imong validated COR o student ID kung naa, kay mahimong kinahanglanon sa ICT para ma-verify nga opisyal kang naka-enroll.
Pwede usab mangayo og tabang sa ICT kung nakalimot ka sa institutional email, dili maka-login, o kinahanglan og account recovery.
